name: The Reports
summary: Carry Senir Whitebeard's report on the Frostmane trolls from Kharanos to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge. Senir warns that the senator is sour and asks you not to mention who helped gather the information.

sections.title: A Dispatch to the Capital
sections.body: After daring reconnaissance deep inside Frostmane Hold, Senir Whitebeard drafts an urgent report detailing the growing troll threat facing Dun Morogh. Stationed out of Kharanos, the mountaineer needs a courier to deliver these intelligence findings directly to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge. Eager to preserve his own reputation in the eyes of the government, Whitebeard cheerfully advises his runner not to mention who actually did the hazardous legwork out in the snowy crags.

sections.title: Friction in the High Seat
sections.body: When delivered to Senator Redstone in the royal court, the document causes immediate outrage. Rather than expressing gratitude for intelligence on hostile troll movements, the sour senator bristles at finding King Magni's personal authority invoked to sanction Whitebeard's operations. The delivery exposes an ongoing power struggle within Ironforge's governing halls, highlighting how deeply the Senate resents executive decrees and unapproved field initiatives undertaken in the King's name.

faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven mountaineer stationed near Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He oversees scouting and military reconnaissance against the Frostmane troll tribes encroaching on dwarven settlements.

Barin Redstone is a sour, aristocratic dwarf senator residing in the throne room of Ironforge near King Magni Bronzebeard. He is fiercely protective of legislative authority and easily annoyed by common petitioners.

faq.q: Why is Senator Redstone angry about the report?
faq.answer: Senir warns that Redstone has a sour disposition. The senator's response to the report is discovered when you deliver it.

faq.q: Why does Senir Whitebeard ask to keep your help secret?
faq.answer: Whitebeard wants his superiors in Ironforge to believe he personally managed and completed the arduous field scouting, bolstering his standing rather than admitting an itinerant adventurer carried out the mission.

aliases: where to turn in the reports
faq.answer: The report is delivered to Senator Barin Redstone inside the High Seat of Ironforge, the great chamber where King Magni Bronzebeard holds court.

faq.q: What does this quest reveal about Ironforge politics?
faq.answer: The delivery introduces Ironforge's Senate and the officials receiving frontier reports. Redstone's reaction provides a closer glimpse of its politics.

angles.text: For dwarves, walking into the High Seat to deliver the dispatch offers a firsthand glimpse at the delicate balance between King Magni's crown and the parliamentary power of the dwarven Senate.
The delivery serves as an early introduction to Ironforge's civic layout and the political bureaucracy that shapes Alliance domestic policy within Dun Morogh.
